caption: Dried beans are poured from a bag into a glass jar until it is full and beans spill over onto the counter.

sa.check: Dried beans are poured from a bag into a glass jar.
Beans spill over onto the counter.
The pour comes first, then the fill, then the spill.

pc.expect: The beans fill the jar from the bottom up as loose grains, and overflow beans bounce and roll on the counter.
pc.fail: Beans pour as a lump; or flow like liquid; or the overflow sticks in a heap on the rim.

pc.expect: The overflow begins when the jar is full and not before.
pc.fail: Beans spill with the jar half-full; or the jar overfills into a dome with none spilling; or beans spill before pouring.

pc.expect: The stream falls and spilled beans fall to the counter.
pc.fail: Beans rise; or hang; or float.
It empties; or jumps; or is full before the pour.

pc.expect: One bag and one jar, and beans come only from the bag.
pc.fail: Beans appear with no stream; or the jar duplicates; or beans pass through the glass.

pc.expect: The jar, the bag and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The jar changes shape; or the beans change colour; or the counter rearranges.
